verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents first-party programmatic surfaces for driving the tenant. These include the My Organization API for in-app administration (auth0-docs-80), Client ID/Secret machine-to-machine access tokens (auth0-docs-54), and tooling that performs tenant operations such as creating apps, managing users and deploying Actions (auth0-docs-41, auth0-docs-77). However, the pack never directly evidences a general-purpose public management API reference, and probes for a published OpenAPI spec all returned 404 (auth0-probe-3). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full public management/authentication API reference, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via API.
